description: Base ouverte des ponts de France is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by CipherBliss EI. Extracted from OpenStreetMap from bridges throughout the French territory. Coverage: CipherBliss EI. The portal shows the English title as "Open base of the bridges of France" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is CipherBliss EI. Its keywords include voies, ouvrages-dart, ponts. The listing shows 2 download or service links in JSON, GEOJSON. The listing shows 2024-10-08 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (http://opendatacommons.org/licenses/odbl/summary/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
